en_title: GTA 6 Players Are Upset Its New Train Can Actually Be Stopped After Spending 13 Years With the Unstoppable GTA 5 Train
cn_title: 与《GTA 5》中无法阻挡的火车相伴13年后，玩家因《GTA 6》的新火车竟然能被拦下而感到失望
opus_summary: 《GTA 5》中无法拦停的火车多年来成为玩家热议的话题，而《GTA 6》的新火车可以被自卸卡车、挖掘机等拦下，甚至会在人站在轨道上时刹车。一些玩家对此感到失望，并制作了突出前作火车实力的粉丝剪辑。

paragraphs.en: GTA 5 's unstoppable train has been a meme for a decade, so naturally, players wasted no time trying to stop the one in GTA 6 – but they were sad to find out that it wasn't all that hard to do.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 5》中无法阻挡的火车已经成为了十年的梗，因此玩家自然立刻尝试拦下《GTA 6》中的火车——但他们伤心地发现，这其实并不难做到。

paragraphs.en: What better way to spend the early days of a project that Rockstar Games fans waited 13 years for than to immediately do the same thing they've already been doing? As players were dropped into the south end of Leonida, many immediately took Jason as far as they could just to find a train to stand in front of.
paragraphs.cn: 对于一款Rockstar粉丝等待了13年的作品，还有什么比立刻做他们一直在做的事更适合度过游戏初期的方式呢？玩家进入Leonida南端后，许多人立刻带着Jason尽可能远地前行，只为了找到一列火车，站到它前面。

paragraphs.en: There is, indeed, a new train screeching over the tracks surrounding Vice City, but there's a problem – it has no aura.
paragraphs.cn: 的确有一列新火车呼啸着驶过Vice City周边的铁轨，但有个问题——它没有气场。

paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》里的火车终于停下来了😭😭😭😭 https://t.co/ly0JOJ0Mb0

paragraphs.cn: 比较《GTA5》《GTA6》和《PDR2》中火车与各种交通工具正面相撞的情况https://t.co/M4CwCbgokx

paragraphs.en: If you're one of the few people who hasn't picked up GTA 5 since it launched in 2013, you still may have heard about its unstoppable train. The iconic black, yellow, and white locomotive patrols Los Santos and has for years, and unlike just about every other vehicle in the game, there's nothing Michael, Franklin, or Trevor can do to stop it.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你是少数自《GTA 5》2013年推出以来一直没玩过这款游戏的人之一，你可能仍然听说过其中那列无法阻挡的火车。这辆标志性的黑黄白三色机车多年来一直在Los Santos穿行，而且与游戏中几乎所有其他载具不同，Michael、Franklin或Trevor都无法阻止它。

paragraphs.en: Dumb trucks, C4, planes, rows of cars – you name it. No one has ever been able to get GTA 5's train to budge. After 13 years of trying, it's become a meme on the internet to try and move the train, resulting in countless videos that have cropped up from those seeking to test its mettle (and farm a bit of engagement on social media).
paragraphs.cn: 自卸卡车、C4、飞机、成排的汽车——能想到的都试过了。从来没有人能让《GTA 5》的火车挪动分毫。经过13年的尝试，试图让火车移动已经成了互联网上的一个梗，无数想要测试其实力的人制作了视频（顺便在社交媒体上蹭一点互动）。

paragraphs.en: Naturally, GTA 6 presented an updated take on the opportunity when players discovered its train. Unfortunately, Rockstar's commitment to realism means moving the new locomotive isn't just possible; it's actually kind of easy. Crash into it with a dump truck? Works like a charm. Park an excavator in its path? Stops it in its tracks. Raise a bridge? Completely detailed. Rockstar's new, smarter NPCs even have the brains to pull the brakes when they see a person simply standing in their way.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家发现《GTA 6》中的火车后，这款游戏自然为他们提供了一个新版的尝试机会。不幸的是，Rockstar对真实性的坚持意味着，让这辆新机车移动不仅是可能的，实际上还有点容易。用自卸卡车撞它？效果好极了。把挖掘机停在它的路线上？能让它当场停下。升起一座桥？完全脱轨。Rockstar的新一代NPC更聪明，甚至懂得在看到有人只是站在路上时刹车。

paragraphs.en: This is where we get into the argument that has plagued Rockstar both inside and outside of the studio for years: When is a game too realistic? Judging by GTA 6's record-breaking earnings and all-time great reviews , it seems the developers' new playground struck a nice balance between being grounded and goofy. Of course, that hasn't stopped a small section of players from being upset that Leonida plays by many of the same rules that we do in the real world.
paragraphs.cn: 这就引出了一个多年来困扰着Rockstar工作室内外的争论：游戏在什么情况下会过于真实？从《GTA 6》破纪录的收入和空前出色的评价来看，开发者打造的新游乐场似乎在贴近现实与荒诞搞怪之间取得了良好的平衡。当然，这并没有阻止一小部分玩家因为Leonida遵循着许多与现实世界相同的规则而感到不满。

paragraphs.en: After GTA 5's train spent more than a decade as the running champ of viral videos to come out of Los Santos, players aren't ready to let GTA 5's train go. In fact, some have began to almost deify the 2013 locomotive, creating fan edits showing the last train as the superior vehicle in the locomotive power-scaling battle.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 5》的火车作为Los Santos热门视频中的常胜冠军已经有十多年了，玩家们还不准备放下它。事实上，一些人已经开始近乎神化这辆2013年的机车，制作粉丝剪辑，表现前作火车在机车实力比较中更胜一筹。

paragraphs.en: "Yeah, this and the 'No first-person mode' are the biggest downsides for me," one X/Twitter user said .
paragraphs.cn: 一位X用户说：「是的，对我来说，这一点和‘没有第一人称模式’是最大的缺点。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. IGN gave it a 10/10 review . For more, you can read about why you probably shouldn't steal the game's parody for Teslas .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。IGN为其打出了10/10分。想了解更多，你可以阅读有关为什么你可能不该偷游戏中影射特斯拉的车辆的报道。
